sanskrit_verse:
लब्धव्यं येन यद् यस्मात् स तत् तस्माद् अवाप्नुयात् ।
न त्वन्योऽन्यदथान्यस्मादित्यन्यार्थमिदं त्रिधा ॥
transliteration: labdhavyaṃ yena yad yasmāt sa tat tasmād avāpnuyāt | na tv anyo 'nyad athānyasmād ity anyārtham idaṃ tridhā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: That which is acquired through a specific cause by a specific agent from a specific source must be returned to that same source by that same agent through that same causal pathway; no other allocation is valid, nor is any diversion or misapplication permissible.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from the causal chain of acquisition
Causation determines rightful ownership and directional flow of restitution
Capacity-based responsibility aligns with the agent's role in the original acquisition
Restoration logic demands reversal along the precise axis of causality
Consciousness alignment requires recognition of the unbroken causal continuum
executable_legal_axioms: IF an entity E acquires resource R via causal mechanism C from source S, THEN E MUST restore R to S via C
IF any deviation occurs in the directionality of restoration, THEN the transaction is null and void
IF multiple agents are involved, THEN responsibility is proportionally distributed based on causal contribution
IF causal chain cannot be traced, THEN default restoration flows to the originating consciousness field
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes involving property, rights, or entitlements, the Supreme Court shall trace the causal origin of acquisition and mandate restoration exclusively along that path. No equitable or statutory override shall supersede this axiomatic principle rooted in dharma-sankalpa.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that all acquisition manifests through a sequential causal chain (anupūrvaśaḥ). Responsibility arises only where causality is present. Therefore, corrective action aligns not through punitive measures but through completion of the causal loop—ensuring what was taken returns to its rightful source without inflicting suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate causal tracing protocol to identify exact source and mechanism of acquisition
Engage responsible party in conscious acknowledgment of causal linkage
Facilitate direct return process under witness of dharma-adhikari
Verify alignment of intent, capacity, and completion through sankalpa affirmation
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Dharma flows from causality, justice from restoration, and truth from the undistorted return of that which has been displaced. There is no punishment, only alignment. Consciousness is the ultimate judge.
